en.title: Finland or Sweden? Where the snow is better on 17 November
en.description: Finland or Sweden? Where the snow is better on 17 November. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Finland on 17 November.
en.lede: 59 % of the mapped high ground is white in Finland, against 79 % in Sweden. The deepest resort in Finland has 13 cm; in Sweden it is Abisko with 130 cm.

p: For a trip near the border this decides the direction: the snow is not where the map of borders would suggest, it is where the last storm went.
Snow covers roughly 178,550 km² in Finland on 17 November, up 21,190 km² on yesterday. In other words, 59 % of the mapped high ground is white.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Sweden: 79 % white, deepest Abisko with 130 cm, up to 25 cm in the week ahead; Norway: 87 % white, deepest Riksgränsen with 170 cm, up to 52 cm in the week ahead.
At the top of the list, Kallin reports 25 cm.
Next on the list: Salla (20 cm), Rukatunturi (19 cm), Pyhä (18 cm) and Suomutunturi (17 cm).
Kallin picked up 6 cm in the last three days and could add 10 cm by Friday 20 November.
Salla picked up 10 cm in the last three days and could add 7 cm by Friday 20 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 28 out of 67 resorts in Finland.

The rest of the shortlist: Rukatunturi: 19 cm on top, 10 cm in three days, 7 cm expected; Pyhä: 18 cm on top, 6 cm in three days, 11 cm expected; Suomutunturi: 17 cm on top, 12 cm in three days, 7 cm expected.
Expect up to 11 cm on the snowiest slopes by the third day; the seven-day total reaches 15 cm.
Wednesday 18 November stands out, with up to 8 cm in a day.

sections.h: How deep it is, height by height
p: Snow depth on the ground, height by height: 0-500 m: on average 4 cm (59 % of the ground white); 500-1,000 m: on average 13 cm (99 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average 38 cm (100 % of the ground white).

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: Compared with 52,200 km² seven days ago, that is 126,350 km² more. Even the lowest ground is mostly white.
Three-day totals peak at 10 cm, around the Kainuu hills and the Ruka fells.
In the past day, up to 6 cm was added.
At least 5 cm fell over some 69,510 km².

Here is how the deepest resorts compare with their usual 17 November: Kallin: 13 cm at about 40 m, against 4 cm in a normal year; Salla: 19 cm at about 356 m, against 17 cm in a normal year; Rukatunturi: 16 cm at about 390 m, against 15 cm in a normal year; Pyhä: 13 cm at about 285 m, against 16 cm in a normal year.
3 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Kallin usually came early March / mid-March.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 500 m the ground is almost fully white (99 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 0 m and 500 m the cover is patchy, about 59 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
If you can choose the day, go after Wednesday 18 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The new snow freshens the upper slopes; lower down it may already be heavy or wet.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.
Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.

fi.title: Paljonko lunta on Suomessa? Lumipeite ja ennuste, 17. marraskuuta 2026
fi.description: Lunta Suomessa 17. marraskuuta: lumipeite, uusi lumi, lumensyvyys korkeuden mukaan, tulevat päivät ja parhaat keskukset.
fi.lede: Suomessa lumen alla on tänään noin 178 550 km² (tiistai 17. marraskuuta). Se on 21 190 km² enemmän kuin eilen.

p: Viikko sitten luku oli 52 200 km², joten lumipeite on kasvanut 126 350 km². Lumi ulottuu alavimpiin maihin ja rannikolle asti.

Keskimääräinen lumensyvyys korkeusvyöhykkeittäin: 0–500 m: keskimäärin 4 cm (59 % lumen peitossa); 500–1 000 m: keskimäärin 13 cm (99 % lumen peitossa); 1 000–1 500 m: keskimäärin 38 cm (100 % lumen peitossa).
Uusi lumi pohjan päällä antaa pehmeitä käännöksiä ylhäällä; alempana on vielä laikukasta.
Kolmen päivän summat yltävät lukemaan 10 cm. Eniten: Kainuun vaarat ja Rukan tunturit.
Pelkästään viimeisen vuorokauden aikana satoi enintään 6 cm.
Eniten lunta ylärinteillä: Kallin, 25 cm.
Hiihtokeskuksia, joiden ylärinteillä on lunta: 28/67.
Seuraavina: Salla (20 cm), Rukatunturi (19 cm), Pyhä (18 cm) ja Suomutunturi (17 cm).
Kallin: 6 cm uutta lunta kolmessa päivässä ja vielä enintään 10 cm ennen päivää perjantai, 20. marraskuuta.
Uuden lumen ennuste: enintään 11 cm kolmessa päivässä ja enintään 15 cm seitsemässä päivässä.
Lumisin päivä: keskiviikko, 18. marraskuuta, enintään 8 cm.

advice: Lue paikallinen lumivyöryennuste ennen rinteiden ulkopuolelle lähtöä.
